title: Fill the horizontal strips

steps.title: Use a ruler or straight edge
steps.body: A ruler or straight edge is required for this activity. Align it with the long horizontal edge of a printed strip.

steps.title: Fill the outlined strip
steps.body: Fill between the two printed boundaries. Follow the changing strip thickness; do not replace it with one thin centre line.

steps.title: Keep the interruptions
steps.body: Leave blank gaps between strips unmarked. Move the straight edge carefully and observe any dragging or smearing during the trial.

steps.title: Compare and record
steps.body: Compare with the digital reference. Record ruler handling, edge control and whether the narrow strips are comfortable to fill.
